---
title: "Mermaid SVG file alternative text"
format:
  html:
    mermaid-format: svg
  docx:
    mermaid-format: svg
  typst:
    mermaid-format: svg
    keep-typ: true
    pdf-standard: ua-1
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - '#fig-svg svg[role="img"][aria-label="SVG file alternative"]'
        - []
    docx:
      noErrors: default
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="SVG file alternative"]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "SVG visible caption")]'
        - []
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'alt:\s*"SVG file alternative"'
        - []
---

See @fig-svg.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-svg
%%| fig-cap: "SVG visible caption"
%%| fig-alt: "SVG file alternative"
flowchart LR
  A[Start] --> B[End]
```
